Hi Patrick / Samantha,

Thanks again for your interest in a hands-on evening clinic next month — we think a focused session with live demos + small breakout rooms will help your engineering and platform teams validate latency and cost profiles against your workload. I put together a proposed coverage matrix (attached) with two host tracks and three breakout rooms so each room can deep-dive on:

- latency/cost tradeoffs for prefix-heavy workloads
- Dedicated vs. Private deployment considerations
- best-fit quantization and batching settings for mid-length sequences

Can you tell us which time window you prefer among these options?
- Tue 2027-10-12 18:00–19:30 PT
- Wed 2027-10-13 19:00–20:30 PT
- Thu 2027-10-14 18:30–20:00 PT

If you confirm a date I’ll lock the bridge, assign hosts, and create a breakout-room picklist so you can sign up for the room most relevant to your team. Attached: coverage_matrix_v3.xlsx (matrix + host assignments), calendar_poll.ics (to add to your calendars).

Thanks —
